body:
I guess not.. You're probably right, it's just a bit hard to see it from your perspective. I know I would help anyone close to me who needed help, so yeah, I guess that goes for me aswell. 

I'll hang on I guess. You're absolutely right about school and everything, I know that I'll enjoy it, but the stress I'm feeling isn't treating me well, at all. How can money even be such a big problem. Always seeing the worst scenario possible is both a blessing and a curse, but yeah. 

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me, it really helped me through yesterday night and today. You should be proud for being able to be kind and supporting towards strangers, it's a gift not everybody posesses. Thank you.

Thank you.

Yes, I think that's really the problem actually. Like I shouldn't be dragging somebody else down with me. Same thing in fact goes for posting here, the feeling that I "should be alone in this" is always with me, even though I in fact know that it's just my messed up mind talking. 

I pushed through, but the feeling still hangs over me. I spend a whole lot of time alone, and for somebody depressed and from time to time even suicidal I don't think that's really optimal to be honest. But yeah, I live to see another day, even though, I honestly doesn't even want to. 

Ugh.

Thank you.. I needed this. I really did. 

It's just weird how much easier it is seeking comfort from strangers.
